blocks.text: Pharming ek sophisticated (chalaak aur technical) tareeqa hai jis mein user ko us ke ilm ke baghair kisi fake (jaali) website par bhej diya jata hai.

Misal: Farz karein aap apne online banking account mein jana chahte hain, lekin pharming attack ki wajah se aap ek counterfeit (naqli) site par pohanch jate hain jo bilkul aap ke bank ki asli site jaisi lagti hai. Agar aap is jaali site par apni login maloomat likh dein to scammer (dhokebaaz) aap ki details le leta hai. Pakistan mein aisa tab ho sakta hai jab hacker us web address ko badal de jo aap browser mein type karte hain, aur aap ek fraudulent (dhoke wali) site par pohanch jayein jo asli (legitimate) site se bohat milti julti hai.

blocks.prompt: MCQ 4: Kaunsa khatra user ko us ke ilm ke baghair jaali websites par le jata hai? Phishing aur pharming mein farq bataiye. (Short question 2)
blocks.explanation: (d) Pharming. (Kitab ki answer key yahan (c) Spyware deti hai, jo ghalat hai.) Farq: phishing mein jaali message (jaise bank ki naqli email) aap ko dhoke se khud link par click karne aur details dene par tayyar karta hai. Pharming mein kisi jaali link ki zaroorat nahi: aap sahi address type karte hain phir bhi hacker ki chhed chhar (web address badalne) ki wajah se aap ko chupke se jaali site par bhej diya jata hai.

items: Pharming: user ko us ke ilm ke baghair naqli website par bhejna (jaise bank ki naqli site).
